items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: I didn't know him so well.

ctx.x: You say that he was very good friends with Jim Noon. Very good friends. Can you tell us anything about Jim Noon?
Jim Noon? I didn't know him so well. No more to see him around the house, you know. But it was his personal friend.
What did he play, Jim Noon?
